name: lms
title: Learning Platform
description: A complete learning management app for Next.js: dashboard with live stats and to-dos, a content library with filters, a content detail page with chapters, trainers and statistics, and learner reports with CSV export. Built in Manrope.
docs:
Installs a full app under app/lms. Run your dev server and open /lms.

It uses the Manrope font (loaded in its layout) and these theme tokens: background, card, muted, accent, border, primary, destructive and chart-1 to chart-5.
